# dsh-diff-view

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
plugin: a reusable two-text diff viewer for client plugins, styled after th

e
harness's native changed-files review. Hunk headers, true line numbers on
both sides, split or uni

fied, word-level highlights, and optional syntax
highlighting through the same engine the native rev

d-level highlights, and optional syntax
highlighting through the same engine the native review uses.

There is no UI of its own to visit. Plugins inject the client service

## Contract

- Hunks follow the native `WorkspaceDiffHunk` shape, plus one extension:
`unnumbered: true` draws no

header and no numbers, for changes whose true
position is unknown. Never lying numbers.
- Multiple

hunks render as ONE continuous file view: when consecutive hunks
skip lines, a gap row ("⋯ 16 unchan

ged lines ⋯") stands in for the hidden
region, and a leading gap appears when the first change start

s deep in the
file. Gaps need true coordinates, so they never render beside an
`unnumbered` hunk.
-

Line numbers come from the diff itself, before any collapse, so they stay
true across hunk boundarie

s.
- Syntax highlighting reuses the `useCodeHighlighter` /
`languageForPath` primitives from the pla

tform seed module, so colors match
the native review. Without a path, or without the primitives, lin

es render
plain. Word highlights never depend on the primitives.
- View mode is per component instan

ce unless the consumer controls it.
- Interactive surfaces pass render props: `onLineToggle(hunkInde

renders a control inside that hunk's @@ header row;
`lineMark(hunkIndex, src)` renders the GitHub-De

ark(hunkIndex) -> boolean` with `onHunkToggle(hunkIndex)` renders
the section checkmark in its own c

olumn left of the line-mark column,
drawn at the section's first changed row (in split view, in whic

hever
pane holds that change).
- The `ddv-*` stylesheet is installed once by this plugin; consumers

render
no CSS of their own for diff rows.
- No persistence; no approval coupling; the host half is a

no CSS of their own for diff rows.
- No persistence; no approval coupling; the host half is a stub.
